Ecommerce & Shopify support

Ecommerce
& Shopify support.

Get the moving parts of your online store working together.

Discuss your project ↗

Based in Poole, Dorset. Working remotely across the UK and internationally.

An ecommerce problem rarely stays in one place. Incorrect product data can affect collections, product cards, feeds and the customer journey. I investigate how the parts connect, then work on the underlying problem.

PRACTICAL ECOMMERCE HELP

From product data to the buying journey.

I have worked with ecommerce catalogues containing more than 5,000 products, supplier information, product variants and the everyday complications of selling online. My support covers Shopify and work across platforms including Etsy, TikTok Shop and Amazon, with the specific platform and task agreed in the brief.

If a product card shows the wrong variant, an import has left inconsistent information or customers cannot find what they need, the first job is to establish why. Changing the appearance alone may leave the cause untouched.

You can bring me a defined problem or ask for a wider ecommerce review. I explain what I find, agree the work and make the practical changes within the access and scope you approve.

Typical areas of support

  • Shopify product and variant problems
  • Product data, SKUs and CSV preparation
  • Supplier catalogue organisation
  • Collections and product navigation
  • Product information and on-page SEO
  • Store and social-platform integration issues

What an ecommerce review looks at.

A focused review starts with the symptoms and the customer journey they affect. I look at the relevant products, data, settings and theme behaviour, then explain the likely cause and sensible options for fixing it.

Before making changes, we agree what is included and how to check the result. Where appropriate, that can mean testing an import on a sample, checking specific variants or reviewing the affected journey after a change.

What I need to get started

Send your store link, a description of the problem and examples of the products or pages affected. Screenshots or a short recording can help. If account access is needed, we arrange appropriate permissions rather than sharing passwords in an enquiry.

A repair, a review and a full store build have different scopes. For a new store or a wider rebuild, see the website and Shopify development service.

RELEVANT EXPERIENCE

Support that gets into the details.

The Selected Projects page includes Shopify troubleshooting and social integration work, alongside other digital projects. The aim is practical: understand the issue and complete the agreed fix, without promising an automatic increase in sales.

Before we start.

Can you fix one Shopify problem?

Yes. Small fixes start from £75. Send the affected page or product and describe what should happen compared with what is happening now.

Will I need a new website?

Not necessarily. A product-data or configuration problem may need a targeted fix. I will explain if the findings point to a larger theme or development issue.

Are apps and platform subscriptions included?

Paid apps, platform subscriptions and other third-party charges are separate unless the written quote specifically includes them.
